name: mlx-serve MCP
description: Bring Apple Silicon AI to your MCP clients — a single stdio bridge to a remote mlx-serve inference server for images, speech, music, video and 3D, with ready-made one-click prompts.

1.0.0: Added: full mlx-serve bridge — images, speech, music, video and 3D generation as MCP tools
Added: 6 one-click prompts (poster, portrait, lo-fi track, speech, 3D, video)
Added: configurable MLX_SERVE_URL / MLX_SERVE_API_KEY / output directory
新增：完整的 mlx-serve 桥接 —— 图像、语音、音乐、视频与 3D 生成 MCP 工具
新增：6 个一键提示词（海报、人像、Lo-Fi 音乐、语音、3D、视频）
新增：可配置的 MLX_SERVE_URL / MLX_SERVE_API_KEY / 输出目录

deploymentOptions.name: Local
deploymentOptions.description: Run the mlx-serve-mcp stdio bridge on your machine, pointed at any mlx-serve instance (local or remote) via MLX_SERVE_URL.

requires.description: Base URL of the mlx-serve instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080 (required)
Bearer token for the mlx-serve instance (only if it is behind auth; optional)

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check connectivity to the remote mlx-serve instance (GET /health). Use this first to verify the ip:port is reachable.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List models available on the remote mlx-serve server with their capability flags (chat/vision, image, speech, music, video, 3D).

tools.name: load_model
tools.description: Explicitly cold-load a model into GPU memory (optionally as the server-wide default).

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model id from list_models, or an absolute path to a model directory on the server

parameters.name: make_default
parameters.description: Also promote it to the server-wide default model

tools.name: unload_model
tools.description: Free a model's GPU memory on the remote server (it stays registered and can be reloaded).

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt; saved as a local PNG with its path returned. Defaults to ddalcu/Mage-Flow-Turbo-MLX-Serve-8bit (best at text in images); use Runpod/FLUX.2-klein-4B for faces.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model id (from list_models); defaults to MLX_SERVE_IMAGE_MODEL

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Edit an existing image with a text prompt; saved as a local PNG. Defaults to Runpod/FLUX.2-klein-4B-mflux-4bit (best for faces).

parameters.name: image_path
parameters.description: Absolute or ~-relative path to the source image (PNG/JPEG)

parameters.name: strength
parameters.description: Denoising strength 0..1 (how much to change the image)

tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.description: Synthesize speech from text; returns a local WAV file path. Defaults to Qwen3-0.6B-TTS-12Hz-MLX-2bit.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: TTS model id; defaults to MLX_SERVE_TTS_MODEL

tools.name: generate_music
tools.description: Generate a music track from a style prompt; returns a local WAV path. Supports text2music, cover and complete tasks, plus bpm/keyscale/vocal_language.

parameters.name: prompt_style
parameters.description: Style description, e.g. 'lo-fi hip hop, mellow piano'

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Music model id; defaults to MLX_SERVE_MUSIC_MODEL

parameters.name: src_audio_path
parameters.description: Local WAV (10-600 s) source for cover/complete tasks

parameters.name: cover_strength
parameters.description: 0..1 how strongly to follow the cover source

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Generate a short video from a text prompt; returns a local MP4 path (H.264, optional AAC soundtrack). Supports first/last frame conditioning.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Video model id; defaults to MLX_SERVE_VIDEO_MODEL

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Pixel width (LTX/H3 default 256; must be divisible by 64)

parameters.name: turbo
parameters.description: Use the distilled 4-step turbo path where available

parameters.name: first_frame_image_path
parameters.description: Optional local image to condition the first frame

parameters.name: last_frame_image_path
parameters.description: Optional local image to condition the final frame

parameters.name: audio_path
parameters.description: Optional local WAV to mix as soundtrack (must match frame duration)

tools.name: generate_3d
tools.description: Generate a textured 3D mesh (GLB) from a subject image; the image should be a clean cutout with real alpha transparency.

parameters.name: image_path
parameters.description: Local PNG/JPEG of the subject (alpha cutout works best)

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: 3D mesh model id; defaults to MLX_SERVE_MESH_MODEL

parameters.name: texture
parameters.description: Request the texture-paint stage for a textured GLB
